desc: Prove/verify the structural lemma that every minimum-weight path has at most three edges by showing the disjointness graph has no induced path with four or more edges.

Derive the exact query formula: direct edge if disjoint; otherwise two-edge paths through intervals completely left or right of both, and one non-dominated three-edge crossing candidate using the endpoint with smaller `L`.
Implement the complete Python solution with prefix/suffix minima, strict inequality handling, INF sentinels, and fast I/O.
Validate the implementation on the provided samples; public sample tests passed.
